after-the-final-dawn.npc: Nilsal, [player name]. It is good to see you.

after-the-final-dawn.player: Likewise, my Queen. How have things been since the Emissaries were dealt with?

after-the-final-dawn.npc: Well, with the cult out of the way, we've been able to refocus on the recent opening of the kingdom. Signing the treaties was only the first step.
There are new opportunities for us in areas such as trade that we're still yet to fully explore.

after-the-final-dawn.text: If A Kingdom Divided has not been completed:

steps.npc: Then of course you have Kourend. The complicated history between our kingdoms means we are yet to sign a treaty with them, but my hope is that will change soon.

after-the-final-dawn.text: If A Kingdom Divided has been completed:

steps.npc: Then of course you have Kourend. The complicated history between our kingdoms means we are yet to sign a treaty with them.
I was hoping to arrange one with their new king, but his reign turned out to be a rather short one. I must confess, I find the continued instability up there to be concerning.
We will have to see how their new king fares. He is young and inexperienced, but he may still have potential...

after-the-final-dawn.npc: Anyway, if there's nothing else, I'm afraid I must return to my work. May the sun light your way, [player name].
